prompt: This is a creative poster with a gold and black color scheme, featuring long, smooth lines, pen drawing, printmaking, minimalism, double exposure and other techniques. The poster uses a black background, with a huge golden arc of ink winding through the entire picture. A large number of Chinese landscapes, pavilions and towers, and the outlines of ancient warriors riding war horses are superimposed on the ink arc. The depiction of Chinese architectural landmarks such as pagodas and temples is delicate and unique. The golden brushstroke-like text and graphics create a smooth artistic effect. The eye-catching "Chang'an" at the bottom is written in large, eye-catching golden characters, which is elegant and generous. This image perfectly combines traditional Chinese art style with modern design elements. --ar 3:4 --v 7
